description: Elections Commission - Declare that A. M. A. Adhikari was selected as the member of the Rambukkana Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Rambukkana Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating a new member by a recognized political party and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This content is specifically about electoral processes and filling elected positions, making it an Elections Gazette.
